parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The data granularity. Valid values are 300 (5 minutes) and 3600 (1 hour). The default value is 300. The actual granularity depends on the time span of the query.

parameters.name: Isp
parameters.description:
The line to query. To query multiple lines, separate them with commas (,). If you specify multiple lines, the data is aggregated. By default, all lines are queried.

Valid values:

- cu: China Unicom.

- cmi: China Mobile.

- ct: China Telecom.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The minimum data granularity is 1 hour.

By default, data from the last 24 hours is read.
